case.title: Our Flag
case.author: Joint Committee on Printing, United States Congress
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF, unchanged. Official GovInfo record identifies House Document 108-97, Our Flag, with the matching package PDF.
case.rightsBasis: U.S. Government publication credited to the Joint Committee on Printing and GPO on physical page 3. External development material, not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: Government-publication provenance recorded for development; no new owner-confirmed rights determination or shipped-catalog admission.

case.reviewStatus: Full conversion and resource gates pass. Page-27 table headers and ten rows are preserved in a warned image. Drop-cap and general flag-group ownership remain unqualified; see measurements/three-fidelity-fixes/record.md.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, library defaults; regression ceiling, not a physical iOS device budget

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Table rows collapse into one paragraph without a table or table image.
knownFidelityIssues.resolution: Source-derived regression, positive controls and complete corpus evaluation: measurements/three-fidelity-fixes/record.md.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Drop-cap body openings become headings and follow their own continuation lines.
State-flag descriptions interleave across columns; figure/name/description ownership is lost.

case.structureCaveat: Populated StructTreeRoot with MarkInfo.Marked=false; no Table/TR/TH/TD roles or Figure Alt text. Tag associations require validation; current converter does not consume the tree.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
